related.title: Magellan 金星雷達探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時鐘偏差、測試脈衝、相位預算及座標版本，保留空間傳播假設。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver clock offsets,test pulses,phase budget and frame revisions while retaining propagation assumptions.
related.difference: 分開斜距解析度、地距解析度與地形造成的幾何畸變。
related.differenceEn: Separate slant-range resolution, ground-range resolution and terrain-induced distortion.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求一週期 5 s，再以 0.5/5 圈換算角度，與公式交叉核對。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。斜距解析度 75 m，相對局部法線的入射角 30°，雷達視向朝右；只比較局部平面。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°。 結果約 150 m。平地近似下地距解析度等於斜距解析度除以入射角正弦；不適用陡坡疊掩區。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the 5 s period,convert 0.5/5 cycles to angle and cross-check the formula.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use 75 m slant-range resolution, incidence 30° from the local normal and right-looking geometry on a local plane. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: δg=δr/sin θ=75/sin 30°. Result ≈ 150 m. For locally flat terrain, ground-range resolution is slant-range resolution divided by the sine of incidence angle; the model fails in layover.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付時鐘偏差、測試脈衝、相位預算及座標版本，保留空間傳播假設。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver clock offsets,test pulses,phase budget and frame revisions while retaining propagation assumptions.
related.difference: 由地面移動速度與曝光時間估算拖影，與像素尺度分開評估。
related.differenceEn: Estimate motion smear from ground speed and exposure, separately from pixel scale.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 先求一週期 5 s，再以 0.5/5 圈換算角度，與公式交叉核對。
以下皆為教學假設，非實際任務參數。教學地面速率 3000 m/s、曝光 0.0001 s、地面像素 0.3 m。 先按量綱手算，再以試算表獨立列式。教學名義算例：b=3000×0.0001/0.3。 結果約 1 pixel。固定視向且無補償時拖影像素數=v地面×t曝光/GSD；假設局部速度固定。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Compute the 5 s period,convert 0.5/5 cycles to angle and cross-check the formula.

All values are teaching assumptions, not mission specifications. Use teaching ground speed 3000 m/s, exposure 0.0001 s and 0.3 m ground sample distance. Calculate by hand with units, then independently formulate a worksheet. Synthetic nominal case: b=3000×0.0001/0.3. Result ≈ 1 pixel. Without image-motion compensation, smear pixels=ground speed×exposure/GSD, assuming constant local speed.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
